title: Where I have shipped real things.

items.overview: UI Health manages healthcare and academic operations across multiple internal systems. Faculty, residency, scheduling, and departmental data need to stay accurate and synchronized across all of them.
responsibilities: Extended and maintained a Node.js sync pipeline across multiple systems, adding validation, handling edge cases, and supporting new data types and systems.
Modernized legacy patient appointment scheduling, event registration, and academic registration workflows into React applications using specification-driven development.
Delivered better UX, WCAG-compliant accessibility, and reliable cross-browser performance across healthcare and academic workflows.
Improved frontend performance using memoization, lazy loading, debounced search and filter workflows, and graceful handling of inconsistent API responses.
Built Chart.js dashboards to help departments monitor scheduling conflicts, residency coverage, and faculty operations.
Accelerated development across workflows using Claude Code for code generation, debugging, and navigating large existing codebases.

items.overview: LPS Health is a cardiovascular health and wellness platform focused on preventive care, educational content, community engagement, and donations. The organization needed reliable digital workflows, so I led a full-cycle website rebuild within a three-month internship.
responsibilities: Replaced a legacy frontend with a modern React architecture as the sole developer in three months, using specification-driven development with GitHub Copilot and Claude to deliver the full rebuild independently.

Improved Lighthouse accessibility score from 40 to 80 and reduced page load time by 70% using lazy loading, image optimization, frontend caching strategies, debounced form handling, state optimization, and accessibility-focused redesign decisions.

Built secure Stripe Checkout workflows with validation, session management, payment recovery handling, and rate-limiting safeguards to improve donation reliability and prevent invalid transaction states.
Used Google Analytics to track bounce rates and time on page across health articles, identify underperforming content, and monitor search term data to improve SEO visibility.

items.overview: Oracle Fusion Cloud builds enterprise applications that support large-scale business operations. I contributed to two Berkshire Hathaway Energy products: BHE-HCM for payroll, scheduling, employee records, and absence management, and BHE-CX Services for field service, work orders, asset maintenance, and inspections.
responsibilities: Built Redwood-style enterprise interfaces for BHE-HCM and BHE-CX workflows including payroll approvals, employee scheduling, absence management, work orders, inspections, and asset maintenance operations.
Supported daily workflows for employees and field service teams across a large-scale energy organization.
Built reusable components for HCM and CX workflows that were adopted across enterprise projects, ensuring UI consistency and cutting redundant development work.
Engineered API integration layers with structured validation and secure REST interactions across distributed Oracle Fusion modules.
Collaborated with backend and QA teams during Agile Scrum release cycles to debug cross-module workflow failures and resolve 100+ production issues across frontend and API layers.
